# Campeyyanāgacariya (Cp 13)

**ID:** Cp 13  
**Section:** Cariyāpiṭaka (cp)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Campeyyanāgacariya  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0512m.mul1.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0512m.mul1.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

It recounts the bodhisatta's practice of perfection (*cariyā*) while reborn as the nāga king Campeyya. In comparative scholarship on canonical Pali narrative literature, André Bareau identifies it as the thirteenth story of the *Cariyāpiṭaka* in relation to the broader Jātaka tradition [Bareau].

**Sources**

- [Bareau] André Bareau, Les récits canoniques du Cariyāpiṭaka et les Jātaka Pāli — Enumeration and spelling of the text as item 13 in the Cariyāpiṭaka sequence.
